Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section sets the rules for companion animal travel handling at Aurelia Skyways so staff complete each step with care and consistency.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk supports passengers by preparing documents, coordinating staff, and protecting the comfort of each animal from check-in to handoff. For boarding, FM-597 is the required form for this process, and staff shall confirm it before any animal enters the controlled area. Passenger concerns receive calm attention, and the welcome team briefs travelers on kennel handling, carrier placement, and the sequence for inspection. The desk records each request in clear language and directs all follow-up to the proper service channel.

When arrival pickup is arranged, EX-417 is the extension used to escalate this process, and staff shall use it when a supervisor review is needed for release or delay. The desk confirms identity, matches the traveler to the animal record, and keeps the exchange orderly so no pet is handed over without authorization. Trained staff give every animal patient attention, maintain a quiet environment, and report any sign of distress at once. If a traveler asks for support, the supervisor listens carefully, explains the next step, and keeps the communication respectful and direct.

For further guidance, contact the senior supervisor at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
